meta.name: PBDS Machine-Addressable Figma Manifest
meta.purpose: Deterministic machine index into canonical PBDS Figma. This file and its explicitly referenced compiled sidecars are mirrors, never visual authority.

authority.rule: A manifest entry may point to Figma truth but may not redefine Figma truth. Unresolved conflicts block PBDS-FREEZE-A.

figmaNavigation.rule: Human and machine navigation resolve to the same canonical Figma objects. This compiled navigation index mirrors Figma information architecture and cannot redefine visual truth.

materialMachineContract.rule: Compiled mirror of approved M1-M5 material canon. Figma remains visual authority. Missing required bindings fail closed.

responsive.rule: PBDS has exactly four global responsive modes. 640px and 1536px are not global PBDS breakpoints; local fluid/component behavior may resolve inside a canonical mode without creating a fifth global mode.

globalMark.name: Brand / Exact 2012 Asterisk
globalMark.rule: Exact 2012 five-leg asterisk geometry is invariant. Do not redraw, approximate, rotate, distort, simplify, or substitute. Functional identity use must preserve the full silhouette and canonical safe zone. Intentional cropping is allowed only when the exact mark is used as oversized recognition artwork in a separately approved PBDS composition.

regionalVariants.name: Brand / Exact 2012 Asterisk / UK RAF
regionalVariants.context: Explicitly UK-facing content and brand applications only
regionalVariants.geometryRule: Use the exact 2012 asterisk silhouette. Do not redraw, rotate, distort, simplify, or substitute. Functional identity use must preserve the full silhouette and safe zone. In separately approved oversized recognition artwork, the whole regional mark may crop as a composition while the roundel remains locked to the asterisk and may not be independently moved, resized, recolored, or transformed.

colorRule.composition: Brand Magenta fills the asterisk. A centered RAF roundel circle is clipped inside the asterisk geometry; all remaining asterisk area stays magenta.

usageContract.name: 05 — Identity Usage Contract — Canonical

clearSpace.rule: Preserve clear space equal to 0.25× the mark's overall width on every side.

surfaceUse.global: Brand Magenta #FF2FAE on both light and dark surfaces; do not auto-invert.
surfaceUse.ukRaf: Retain approved regional colors on both light and dark surfaces; do not auto-invert.

opacity.rule: Identity marks are always 100% opacity. Never fade the asterisk, roundel, or any internal color layer. Atmospheric effects belong behind the mark.

placementAndCropping.functionalIdentity: Full silhouette plus safe zone; cropping prohibited.
placementAndCropping.recognitionArtwork: Oversized exact asterisk may intentionally crop only when the crop is part of a separately approved PBDS composition. Cropping never creates new geometry or a new logo.

usageContract.ukRafSpecific: Never move, resize, recolor, or independently transform the roundel inside the asterisk. Never extract the roundel as a substitute logo.

favicon.selectionEvidence: Decision history is retained in Notion; rejected candidate board 2928:121 was deleted from Figma after approval.

exportContract.name: 07 — Favicon / App-Icon Export Contract — Canonical
exportContract.browserExceptionRule: Browser favicon chrome may render the exact mark at 16 px. This waives only the 24 px minimum-size rule; geometry, color, opacity, and no-container rules remain invariant.
exportContract.touchAppClearSpace: 0.25× mark width per side; mark occupies 2/3 of the transparent square canvas.
exportContract.invariant: No favicon export may redraw, simplify, recolor, rotate, distort, fade, add a container, or substitute the Exact 2012 Asterisk.

legacyMark.name: Legacy / Brand / 5×5 Glyph
legacyMark.migrationPolicy: Existing historical consumers remain in place until a separately approved bounded migration step.

variableInventory.rule: Every listed variable has a stable Figma ID, canonical name, type, layer and legacy status; owner, allowedConsumers and implementationDestination are explicitly inherited from its collection. Figma remains value authority.

referencePages.name: PBDS / REF / Responsive Structure Study
referencePages.allowedUse: Inspect the approved four breakpoint regimes only. Do not copy page content, component styling, spacing, shell treatment, proof UI, CTA treatment, metrics, artifacts, recognition composition, or information architecture from this study.

responsiveWireframes.rule: Only the four breakpoint regimes and their canonical canvas widths are approved. Every visible page design decision inside this study is schematic and non-canonical until separately designed and approved from PBDS primitives, components, patterns, recognition, and motion contracts.
responsiveWireframes.qa: Demotion QA completed after the board/page were relabeled NOT Visual Canon. Prior screenshot QA only proved the study rendered without overlap; it did not approve the design.

componentSets.name: PBDS/Action/Case Study Primary CTA
componentSets.machineDescription: F2.5 machine description — Canonical primary action for an approved Personal Career Brand case-study composition. Use when a reader is moving from a case-study preview, summary, or other entry surface into that consuming case's full canonical case-study destination. The consuming case owns the destination/slug and all story truth; this component owns only the primary VIEW CASE STUDY ↗ affordance. Breakpoint selects the approved responsive geometry only; Tone changes surface treatment only; State changes interaction state only. Do not use this component for Book a Call, evidence/proof links, downloads, external references, or generic actions. Do not create, infer, rename, or reclassify case-study destinations, and do not alter narrative, metrics, taxonomy, or proof. Preserve the approved case destination and story; placement is composition-owned.

patterns.name: PBDS/Pattern/Header/Case Study Identity
patterns.machineDescription: F2.5 machine description — Canonical case-study identity header for the approved Personal Career Brand case-study system. Use at the top of a case-study composition to identify Jim Markunas and establish CASE STUDY context; Name, Case Study, and Domain are semantic content slots supplied by the consuming case. Case-specific truth comes from the canonical 17-case career/case-study canon: exactly one primary category, optional secondary category, exactly one context sub-bucket, optional secondary/signature angles, and controlled internal dynamics. This pattern does not own or rewrite classification, narrative spine, metrics, proof, or story copy. Tone=Light/Dark changes visual treatment only. Do not infer taxonomy or story meaning from placeholder text, geometry, or tone; populate from canonical case content and preserve the approved story.

retiredArtifacts.retiredReason: Legacy V1 machine handoff encoded obsolete md/lg/xl breakpoint language and blue/red design semantics that conflict with PBDS 2.0. Git history remains the archive; cold-start agents must not use it.
Rejected favicon candidate exploration. Not visual authority after Candidate A approval; decision history retained in Notion.

knownConflicts.problem: Current Figma plan/seat does not expose Code Connect enumeration. PBDS must not depend on Code Connect for determinism unless availability changes.

Inter Display is canonical for Brand Native display/headline/proof roles, but the current Figma automation runtime cannot load Inter Display for direct text-property mutation. Existing canonical style objects must be preserved; automation may use geometry-only edits where safe and must not silently substitute a different font as canonical visual truth.
